look: Held-back product demo: the real ng-prism styleguide, lifted from its build, on the dark brand ground with its three soft glows; one developer showing another, captions as a lower third with the brand gradient on the emphasised words, no marketing speak

scenes.name: Version 22.7
scenes.desc: Out of the mark's own blurred light the camera pulls back until the prism is sharp; a flare runs through it, the name slides out from behind it, 22.7 settles below.

scenes.name: Dark and light
scenes.desc: The styleguide in its new look; the theme button switches it to light and back.

scenes.name: Service pages
scenes.desc: From the Time Ago pipe page, a click on Notification Service opens the service's own API page.

scenes.name: Real templates
scenes.desc: The Field showcase types itself in beside the styleguide, which renders its compiled template.

scenes.name: Parts
scenes.desc: The List Item showcase gets partOf; its chip shows on the List page, and a click opens the part's inputs and outputs.

scenes.name: Accepted
scenes.desc: The Form Field variant accepts the color-contrast rule with a reason; the A11y tab lists it as accepted, and the score stays 100.

scenes.name: Bundle size
scenes.desc: The Performance tab shows the size of the shipped source, without @Showcase and comments.

scenes.name: ng update
scenes.desc: End card: the ng-prism logo and the update command.
